sections.html:
• Presentation: Deep venous thrombosis, Pulmonary embolism
  • Etiology: จำแนกได้ 3 กลุ่มตาม “Virchow triad” — 1. Venous stasis 2. Vascular injury 3. Hypercoagulable state

Well's Criteria for DVTPoints
Active Cancer(1)
Paralysis, paresis, recent immobilization of lower extremity(1)
Recently bedridden for >3days, or major surgery in last 4 weeks(1)
Localized tenderness along distribution of the deep venous system(1)
Entire leg swollen(1)
Calf swelling by >3cm compared to asymptomatic leg(1)
Pitting edema (greater in symptomatic leg)(1)
Collateral, nonvaricose superficial veins(1)
Alternative diagnosis as or more likely than DVT(-2)

Wells, P.S. et al. (2003). Evaluation of D-dimer in the diagnosis of suspected deep-vein thrombosis. New England Journal of Medicine; 349: 1… (ข้อความอ้างอิงถูกตัดท้ายในหนังสือ)

Well's Criteria for PEPoints
Clinical Signs and Symptoms of DVT (leg swelling and pain with palpation of the deep veins)(3.0)
Alternative diagnosis less likely than PE(3.0)
Heart rate >100bpm(1.5)
Immobilization or surgery in last 4 weeks(1.5)
Previous DVT or PE(1.5)
Hemoptysis(1.0)
Malignancy (ongoing or previous 6 months)(1.0)

Wells P.S, et al. (2000). Derivation of a simple clinical model to categorize patients probability of pulmonary embolism: increasing the models utility with the SimpliRED D-dimer. Thromb Haemost 2003; 83: 416-20.

Writing Group for the Christopher Study Investigators. (2006). Effectiveness of managing suspected pulmonary embolism using an algorithm combining clinical probability, D-Dimer testing, and computer tomography. JAMA;295: 172-179.

  • Fracture: hip, knee
  • Spinal cord injury
